name: Gateway Auth Flow
description: Validates the complete dev-mode authentication flow through the gateway: dev login produces a JWT and clearance level, and the JWT is accepted on a subsequent authenticated request. Session refresh requires the httpOnly seti_refresh cookie which plot-test cannot maintain — refresh is verified by the system's own inter-service traffic, not this plot.
